what_was_found: Published Co-IP is negative: CLDN4, TJP1, OCLN did not co-IP with TACSTD2 at any detergent tested. IntAct records PLA proximity only (EBI-9302237), not Co-IP. No AlphaFold2/Multimer paper of a TROP2–CLDN4 complex.
what_was_not_found: No positive Co-IP; no AF2 TROP2–CLDN4 structure.
